identity: YELYGINN — editorial cyber-brutalism with cinematic glass depth

accent_policy.rule: photo-derived colors may dominate an artwork but do not become permanent UI tokens

typography.display: Inter Bold or similarly hard grotesk
typography.interface: Roboto Mono Regular or neutral mono

grid.three_items: use dedicated 3-column grid; never reserve a blank fourth cell

glass.rule: glass appears only when there is image/gradient depth behind it; brutal structure stays visible outside glass

gradients.rule: broad soft low-frequency fields, never rainbow or neon tubes
gradients.warm: signal orange → transparent over paper or ink
gradients.digital: violet → transparent over paper or ink
gradients.usage: background atmosphere, hero media, selected cards; not every section

image_language: scanline or directional blur when justified
